The options considered for KYB verification were:

The chosen integration design was to use VeriTrust synchronously in the provisioning flow, meaning the provisioning process calls the verification API and waits for the result before creating the workspace. This synchronous design was selected to meet the compliance deadline in September 2026 [S4].

Because verification was a blocking step, these timeouts delayed onboarding for 63 new customers and generated many support tickets. The synchronous waiting caused onboarding to be blocked directly by VeriTrust's latency and availability issues [S1][S3][S6]. To mitigate this, a move to an asynchronous job queue design is planned for Q4 2026 [S1].

After INC-204, the timeout for calls to the verification provider VeriTrust was increased to 15 seconds with exponential backoff retries (3 retries), and an alert was added for when the verification timeout rate exceeds 5% over 15 minutes. Additionally, a higher rate limit with VeriTrust was agreed upon to reduce timeouts [S1].

What is still planned is to move the verification step from a synchronous call in the provisioning flow to an asynchronous job queue. This change will allow provisioning to resume automatically when verification completes, avoiding blocking onboarding. This asynchronous design is targeted for Q4 2026 [S1][S2].
